question: Which sector has the highest percentage share of goods exports in the annual GDP (at current prices) for the year 2020-21?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Engineering Goods.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **According to the data provided, the sector that has the highest percentage share of goods exports in the annual GDP (at current prices) for the year 2020-21 is Engineering Goods.**
 
• Engineering Goods include various products such as** machinery, electrical equipment, vehicles,** and parts thereof.
 
• These goods are in high demand globally and are exported to various countries.
 
• The percentage share of Engineering Goods in the annual GDP (at current prices) for the year **2020-21** could be higher due to the impact of the **COVID-19 pandemic **on other sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electronic Goods, Drugs and Pharmaceuticals, and Organic and Inorganic Chemicals are also major export sectors in India.**
 
• **The services sector accounted for about half of India's GDP in 2022, indicating a gradual but consistent growth over the previous ten years.**
 
 
• Of India's 179.15 lakh crore Indian rupees, or** 53.89% **of the total, are accounted for by the services sector.
 
• At Rs. **46.44 lakh crore** in GVA, the industry sector makes up **25.92%** of the total.
 
• However,** 20.19% **goes to the **agricultural** and related sectors.
